On the day when the Jews were celebrating the Pentecost festival, the believers were all together in one place {in the city of Jerusalem}.
Suddenly a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.
And suddenly a sound came from heaven, as of a strong wind being borne along, and it filled the whole house where they were sitting.
Suddenly, they heard a noise coming from the sky that sounded like a wind blowing loudly. Everyone in the entire house where they were sitting heard the noise.
They saw tongues like flames of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.

Then they saw what looked like burning flames. These flames separated from one another and came to rest on each of the believers.

Then the Holy Spirit empowered all of the believers. They began to speak in languages they had never learned. The Spirit was making it possible for them to do that fluently. \*
Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.
Now there were Jews living in Jerusalem, godly men, from every nation of those under heaven.

At that time many Jews were staying in Jerusalem {to celebrate the Pentecost festival}. They were Jewish people who sincerely worshiped God. They had come from many different countries around the world.
